caseNameFull: Duncan, Superintendent, Great Meadow Correctional Facility v. Walker

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 991.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Deborah Wolikow Loewenberg, Esq., of New City, N. Y., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
